subject: Remove REDIS tag from test macros. (#333)
reason: The change only renames the REDIS_TEST_* macros in testhelp.h to TEST_* and updates their uses in the internal unit-test functions (dictTest, listpackTest, quicklistTest, utilTest, ziplistTest) and the 'valkey-server test' flag parser. The macro values are identical and the code is test-harness-only, never executed while serving clients, replicating, or persisting. It is a pure refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
